content:
elaine-finance: Heads up  saw a ~9.8k USD untagged GPU spike in the interactive-notebooks pool overnight (ids: nb-981, nb-982). Billing shows owner=null.

omar-ops: On it. Can you paste run ids/times? I'll check node spin-up logs and who requested the reservation.

elaine-finance: nb-981 2026-03-20T23:40Z->2026-03-21T07:12Z, nb-982 23:58Z->07:40Z. billing-bot flagged as untagged charge 9876.12 USD.

billing-bot: auto: detected untagged consumption 9876.12 USD; resources: nb-981,nb-982; recommended temporary budget cap + dry-run alert on create when owner missing.

ravi-ml: Likely the self-serve reservation flow. We currently allow shared service accounts for some infra tests which omit owner metadata.

elaine-finance: Short-term: 1) apply an alert-only daily cap of 1,000 USD on the notebook pool, 2) enable dry-run create-time alerts when owner tag missing, 3) run a 60-day backfill to try to assign owners.

omar-ops: I'll create INFRA-4301 for budget cap and alert. Can implement dry-run alert in Prometheus within the hour. Backfill job needed from platform team.

ravi-ml: I'll kick off the backfill heuristic (match session cookies and IAM audit logs). Expect ~95% match, report in 3 days.

elaine-finance: Thanks. After backfill, finance will propose allocation for any residual unassigned costs (central research pool vs pro-rata). Follow-up sync tomorrow 10am PT.

billing-bot: auto: budget guard (alert-only) applied: https://infra.internal/budgets/notebook-pool

omar-ops: INFRA-4301 created, linking logs and alert rule.

elaine-finance: Marking this urgent; please @channel if new untagged runs appear.
